+++ b/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/AlgebraicJacobian/RiemannRoch/Adelic/GlobalGeneration.lean
@@ -570,5 +570,84 @@ theorem residueDeg_eq_one_iff_hasRationalResidues (P : X.PrimeDivisor)
 
 end RationalResidues
 
+/-! ## §6. The rational-residue case: `r = 1` and the unweighted degree
+
+Under `HasRationalResidues` at every prime divisor — the substrate's form of "the base
+field is algebraically closed" — the two hypotheses that §4 and `SectionBounds.lean` §4
+left open both become discharged simultaneously, because both were the same fact:
+
+* the uniform generation bound gets `r = 1`, so the threshold is `b + 1`;
+* `deg_k = deg` (`degK_eq_degree_of_residueDeg_eq_one`), so the weighted statements
+  become statements about the geometric degree — in particular the principal-degree-zero
+  leaf.
+
+This is the precise pay-off of §5: one approximation hypothesis, two consequences.
+-/
+
+section RationalResidueConsequences
+
+variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
+    [IsNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
+    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)
+
+/-- **Rational residues everywhere give residue degree one everywhere.** -/
+theorem residueDeg_eq_one_of_hasRationalResidues
+    (hres : ∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, HasRationalResidues k P)
+    [∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)]
+    (P : X.PrimeDivisor) : residueDeg k P = 1 :=
+  (residueDeg_eq_one_iff_hasRationalResidues k P).mpr (hres P)
+
+/-- **Uniform global generation with threshold `b + 1`.**  With rational residues at
+every point, the residue-degree bound of `exists_bound_forall_generatedAt` is `r = 1`, so
+one threshold works for every point and the shift over the vanishing bound is a single
+unit.
+
+This is the classical shape: above `deg D ≥ b + 1`, `𝒪(D)` is generated by global
+sections everywhere.  It remains single-field. -/
+theorem exists_bound_forall_generatedAt_of_hasRationalResidues
+    (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D)
+    (D₀ : X.WeilDivisor) (hbase : Subsingleton (H1Mod k U₀ U₁ D₀))
+    (hpeel : ∀ D' : X.WeilDivisor,
+      (∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D₀) P ≤
+        (show X.PrimeDivisor →₀ ℤ from D') P) →
+      Peel k U₀ U₁ D₀ D')
+    (hres : ∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, HasRationalResidues k P)
+    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k ⊤ D)]
+    [∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)] :
+    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, b ≤ degK k D →
+      ∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, GeneratedAt k D P :=
+  exists_bound_forall_generatedAt k U₀ U₁ hledger D₀ hbase hpeel 1
+    (fun P => le_of_eq (residueDeg_eq_one_of_hasRationalResidues k hres P))
+
+/-- **The weighted degree is the geometric degree, under rational residues.**  Together
+with `degK_principal_eq_zero` this is the unweighted principal-degree-zero statement; see
+`degree_principal_eq_zero_of_residueDeg_eq_one` (`SectionBounds.lean`), whose residue
+hypothesis is now reduced to `HasRationalResidues`. -/
+theorem degK_eq_degree_of_hasRationalResidues
+    (hres : ∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, HasRationalResidues k P)
+    [∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)]
+    (D : X.WeilDivisor) : degK k D = Scheme.WeilDivisor.degree D :=
+  degK_eq_degree_of_residueDeg_eq_one k
+    (fun P _ => residueDeg_eq_one_of_hasRationalResidues k hres P)
+
+/-- **Principal divisors have geometric degree zero, from the ledger plus rational
+residues.**  The adelic route to the open leaf
+`Scheme.WeilDivisor.principal_degree_zero`, with both of its inputs now named: the closed
+ledger and the approximation statement `HasRationalResidues`.
+
+Compare `degree_principal_eq_zero_of_residueDeg_eq_one`: that took residue-degree-one on
+the support as a hypothesis; here it is derived from the approximation form, which is the
+statement one can actually hope to discharge from algebraic closedness. -/
+theorem degree_principal_eq_zero_of_hasRationalResidues
+    (hledger : ∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, chi k U₀ U₁ D = chi k U₀ U₁ 0 + degK k D)
+    (hres : ∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, HasRationalResidues k P)
+    [∀ P : X.PrimeDivisor, Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)]
+    {g : X.functionField} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
+    Scheme.WeilDivisor.degree (Scheme.WeilDivisor.principal g hg) = 0 :=
+  degree_principal_eq_zero_of_residueDeg_eq_one k U₀ U₁ hledger hg
+    (fun P _ => residueDeg_eq_one_of_hasRationalResidues k hres P)
+
+end RationalResidueConsequences
+
 end Adelic
 end AlgebraicGeometry
